task: Identify sister regional/vertical insurtech community organizations to InsurTech NY, and pull multi-year census data (startup maps, sponsor/exhibitor lists, competition winners, accelerator cohorts) where accessible.

orgs.name: InsurTech NY
orgs.status: real, active, already-known baseline for this project
orgs.new_data_this_pass: own multi-year event history (2019-2026), competition winners/finalists (2020-2026), 2026 sponsor list, and a recovered 2023 static NYC map (50 companies) distinct from the already-merged current 142-company map

orgs.name: InsurTech America network (Hartford / Chicago / Atlanta / New England / Florida / Carolinas)
orgs.status: REAL and CONFIRMED - all 6 chapter sites exist and are live, founded/led by Stacey Brown (InsurTech Hartford founded 2016, expanded via Chicago/Atlanta/New England/Florida/Carolinas). This is a SEPARATE network from InsurTech NY, not a rebrand of it.
orgs.startup_directory: none - no chapter publishes a company map/directory like InsurTech NY's
orgs.multiyear_census_mechanism: InsurTech Hartford's annual 'Innovation Challenge' (presented with ACORD) - winner/finalist lists recovered for 2020, 2021, 2022, 2024 (2019, 2023 not found)
orgs.coverage: PARTIAL - Hartford chapter only; Chicago/Atlanta/New England/Florida/Carolinas challenge histories not found in this pass

orgs.name: Global Insurance Accelerator (GIA)
orgs.status: REAL, ACTIVE, founded 2014 - the original/oldest US insurtech-focused accelerator; ~85 alumni claimed
orgs.coverage: PARTIAL - portfolio page is JS-rendered and not scrapeable by fetch/curl; only scattered press-covered cohorts recovered (2014-15, 2016-17, 2024). Years 2017-2023, 2025, 2026 rosters exist but were not recovered.

orgs.name: Silicon Valley Insurance Accelerator (SVIA)
orgs.status: REAL but appears to have CLOSED its main operations (per search result) - founded 2016, ran through ~2023-2024 based on available signal
orgs.multiyear_census_mechanism: claimed 400+ startups showcased across its run, but no itemized roster found
orgs.coverage: NONE - portfolio page returned only event-logistics boilerplate, no company names

orgs.name: Plug and Play Insurtech
orgs.type: accelerator batches, Sunnyvale CA (part of Plug and Play Tech Center) + regional programs (Singapore/APAC, Europe)
orgs.status: REAL, VERY ACTIVE, high volume (10-35+ insurtechs per batch, multiple batches/year)
orgs.multiyear_census_mechanism: numbered batches (e.g. 'Insurtech Batch 20' SV 2026, 'Insurtech Batch 5' Singapore) - functionally a multi-year, multi-region cohort census
orgs.coverage: MOSTLY GATED - press releases cite aggregate counts, rarely name individual insurtech companies. Only 2 companies recovered by name (AppliedAI, Zopper). Full batch rosters live on plugandplay.com behind bot-detection.

orgs.name: gener8tor Insurance & Wealth Accelerator (fka OnRamp Insurance Accelerator)
orgs.type: accelerator, Minneapolis/St. Paul MN, backed by Allianz Life + Securian Financial
orgs.status: REAL, ACTIVE, founded 2019, ~6 cohorts run through 2024
orgs.coverage: PARTIAL - 4 of ~6 years recovered (2020, 2021, 2022, 2024); 2019 and 2023 not found; unclear if it ran in 2025/2026
orgs.scope_caveat: branded 'Insurance & Wealth' - roughly half the recovered names are wealth-management/fintech, not insurance-core

orgs.name: Scout InsurTech
orgs.type: community/conference + seasonal startup-scouting program, Columbus OH
orgs.status: REAL, ACTIVE - CEO Chris Luiz, annual conference (next: May 2026), overlaps geographically with InsurTech Ohio
orgs.multiyear_census_mechanism: seasonal numbered cohorts (F6S lists 'Scout Insurtech S24', implying dozens of prior seasons) naming 'top 20 emerging startups' per cycle - this IS a genuine multi-year census structure
orgs.coverage: NONE - could not get past F6S's bot-detection wall to see the actual S24 roster or any other season

orgs.name: InsurTech Denver / InsurTech ATX (Austin) / InsurTech Ohio
orgs.status: all REAL and ACTIVE, unaffiliated with InsurTech America or InsurTech NY
orgs.coverage: NONE - none publish a startup directory or company census; events/newsletter content only

orgs.name: Bermuda insurtech community
orgs.type: N/A - does not exist as an independent org
orgs.status: NOT A REAL STANDALONE ORG - Bermuda's insurtech engagement runs through the Bermuda Business Development Agency (BDA), a government economic-development body, which partners directly with InsurTech NY's Competition (sponsors a 'Bermuda BDA Winner' category) rather than running its own community/census.

orgs.name: InsurTech Georgia
orgs.type: candidate checked, not confirmed as distinct from InsurTech Atlanta
orgs.status: SEARCH DID NOT SURFACE a distinctly-named 'InsurTech Georgia' org separate from InsurTech Atlanta (part of the InsurTech America / Stacey Brown network, see above). Likely the user's 'InsurTech Georgia' candidate name = InsurTech Atlanta.
orgs.coverage: N/A - folded into InsurTech Atlanta entry above

orgs.name: MetLife Digital Accelerator (powered by Techstars) / Nationwide accelerator
orgs.type: single-corporate accelerator, not a community org
orgs.status: MetLife's program is REAL (Techstars-run, Cary NC, 10 startups/cohort, $120K each) but is a private corporate accelerator, not a public community-facing org with an ongoing directory. Nationwide's accelerator: no community-facing program with public cohort data found.
orgs.coverage: NOT PURSUED FURTHER - out of scope vs. the community/directory-style orgs this task targets; flagging for awareness only, no file built
